blind.description: An ornate square architectural pillar featuring an integral stepped plinth base, paneled shaft with gold molding, flared capital, and a red Eastern-style dragon coiled around it. The dragon rests its upper torso and clawed forelimbs on the top ledge with head facing forward, golden horns, small folded red wings along its flank, and a long scaled serpentine body that wraps helically downward around the shaft. Surfaces are solid and continuous with no broken shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or thin floating flakes. Nothing hovers unattached, and there is no melted or distorted geometry. It stands on its own integral square plinth whose underside sits flat on the floor. Colors consist of crimson red scales with bright metallic gold horns, dorsal crest, and claws on the dragon, and dark bronze or stone panels with gilded ornamental trim on the pillar. There are no plain black or unpainted areas, and no flame or glow.
blind.from_above: From directly above, the model shows the crouching red dragon centered on the square capital of the pillar. The dragon's red scaly back and golden spined dorsal ridge run down the middle, with its head and two golden horns projecting forward over the front edge. Two clawed front limbs are splayed outward gripping the lateral edges of the capital, and the square gold-trimmed rim of the pillar platform frames the creature beneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: The model is approximately 9 to 10 feet tall (about 1.6 to 1.7 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), with the dragon and capital sitting well above the figure. The square base and capital are approximately 3.5 to 4 feet wide (about two-thirds the height of the figure, spanning most of one 5-foot floor grid square).
